_comment: Ablation: do the three columns the EDA calls signal-free (brand, storage_type, nutrition_score) earn their tokens? config.json trains on all three, while comentarios_para_el_equipo/ANALISIS_COLUMNAS.md argues each is indistinguishable from chance (brand chi2=14.6 with 14 dof, storage_type chi2=1.1, nutrition_score r=-0.019, all flat inside the high-intent tier too). Run with: python main.py --config config/no_signal_columns.json. Architecture, optimizer, splits and seed are identical across the five experiments, so the only thing that changes is which feature tokens the encoder is handed.
_comment_early_stopping: 0 disables early stopping: every epoch always runs, so each experiment gets exactly the same budget and no comparison is confounded by one arm stopping sooner. Checkpoint SELECTION still happens -- the weights that get tested are the epoch with the best early_stopping_metric -- so the honest phrasing for a slide is 'N epocas fijas + seleccion de checkpoint por val PR-AUC', not 'early stopping'. It was 100 with fewer epochs than that, which could never fire.

experiments.name: control_all_features
experiments._comment: The config.json feature set, repeated here so the four ablations below are read against a run of this exact file rather than against a number from another config. Sequence is [CLS] + 10 product_name subwords + 2 numeric + 5 categorical = 18 positions.

experiments.name: drop_brand
experiments._comment: brand alone. Note the usual argument for dropping it -- 'brand is already the literal prefix of title' -- does NOT apply to this pipeline: process_title_column strips the brand prefix out of product_name, so the text tokens do not carry it. This run therefore removes the brand information entirely, not just a duplicate of it.

experiments.name: drop_storage_type
experiments._comment: storage_type alone. The weakest column in the analysis (BTR spread 0.010, chi2=1.1), and nearly determined by category, which stays in.

experiments.name: drop_nutrition_score
experiments._comment: nutrition_score alone. Also the only run that changes the numeric block, and it removes the column whose raw 0-99 scale makes its tokens roughly 100x longer than the categorical ones (see NumericTokenizer, and the unapplied normalization in get_data_processed).

experiments.name: drop_all_three
experiments._comment: All three at once, i.e. the feature set the EDA actually recommends: price as the one numeric, category/allergens/title_tag as the categoricals. 15 positions instead of 18. If this matches the control, config.json should be trimmed to it.
